name: Linkages 68
definition: Information related to a linked transaction.

ProcessingPosition.name: Processing Position
ProcessingPosition.definition: Specifies when the transaction is to be executed relative to a linked transaction.

MessageNumber.name: Message Number
MessageNumber.definition: Message type number/message identifier of the message referenced in the linkage sequence.

LinkedQuantity.name: Linked Quantity
LinkedQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instruments of the linked transaction to be paired-off or turned.

LinkedQuantityRule.definition: If linked quantity for partial pair-off and turned quantity for partial turns is used, then its usage must be pre-agreed between the message account owner and account servicer.
